key_results: Eliminates error floors of conventional methods; achieves optimal symbol detection at low pilot power ratios; improves spectral efficiency in dynamic UAV scenarios
comments: Leverages sensing data (position/velocity) as prior information to mitigate pilot-data interference—a practical fusion of sensing and communication.

model_io.model: Two-stage delay-Doppler denoising + sensing-assisted iterative decision-directed mechanism
inputs: received OFDM signal with superimposed pilots

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sensed prior bounds can reduce estimation error via adaptive thresholding
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; error floors eliminated and convergence improved

title: Dynamic adjustment strategy of sensor nodes based on artificial fish swarm algorithm
task: Dynamic sensor node adjustment for wireless sensor network coverage via artificial fish swarm algorithm
key_results: Achieves full coverage with fewer nodes; expands sensing directions for maximum coverage; extends network lifetime via energy-balanced node selection
comments: Problem formulation and algorithm are reasonable, but paper lacks quantitative metrics (coverage %, energy gain %) and experimental rigor.

model_io.model: Fixed-location deployment + preliminary AFSA-based direction adjustment + real-time target tracking + optimal node selection
inputs: Sensor node positions and sensing ranges

hypotheses.hypothesis: AFSA-guided sensing direction optimization balances coverage and energy consumption
hypotheses.result: Claimed but not quantitatively validated

title: Tube-MPC-based trajectory tracking control for robotic manipulators
task: Robust trajectory tracking for manipulators under input constraints and disturbances via Tube-MPC
key_results: 45.8% RMSE reduction vs. conventional Tube-MPC; convergence time reduced 38.6%; strong robustness to time-varying torque disturbances
comments: Fixed-time SMC embedded in tube dynamics is theoretically sound; Lyapunov stability proven, but validation limited to simulation.

model_io.model: MPC (nominal control) + nonlinear disturbance observer + adaptive tube radius + fixed-time SMC

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adaptive tube radius reduces conservatism and improves convergence
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 38.6% faster convergence than fixed-tube baseline

title: Product appearance sensory evaluation model using Qualia Theory and AHP for Chaozhou woodcarving crafts
task: Sensory evaluation framework for woodcarving crafts using Qualia Theory and AHP
key_results: Five-dimensional criterion layer with 15 sub-indicators; craftsmanship delicacy (weight 0.320) and engineering integrity (0.250) dominate; fuzzy evaluation satisfaction scores 77.72–80.52%
comments: Data-driven heritage modernization is valuable, though AHP CR threshold not met for all dimensions and sample validation (2699/9784) indicates selection bias.

model_io.model: AHP weighting + fuzzy comprehensive evaluation + parameter-driven 3D modeling

hypotheses.hypothesis: Craftsmanship delicacy and engineering integrity are user preferences over pure aesthetic appeal
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Aesthetic Appeal weighted lowest (0.090)

title: Depth-augmented diffusion policy with pseudo-depth for robust robotic manipulation
task: Depth-augmented diffusion policy for robotic manipulation via stochastic feature fusion and pseudo-depth
key_results: Sensor depth: 95% success on toilet-seat-lid closing task; pseudo-depth (Depth Anything V2): 90% success vs. 50% RGB-only, 75% 3D Diffusion Policy; modest consistent gains on LIBERO simulation across three task suites
comments: Practical depth conditioning mechanism (stochastic feature addition + modality dropout); pseudo-depth via monocular estimation removes RGB-D camera dependency—valuable for deployment.

model_io.model: Diffusion Policy: separate visual encoders (RGB, depth) + stochastic feature-level fusion + modality dropout
inputs: Sensor depth map (or pseudo-depth from Depth Anything V2)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit depth conditioning improves distance-sensitive manipulation; pseudo-depth viable alternative to RGB-D
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 95% real-world success with sensor depth, 90% with pseudo-depth

title: Enhancing out-of-hospital emergency care via lexical machine learning modeling of chief complaints
task: Lexical machine learning for predicting lifesaving interventions from EMS chief complaints
key_results: Six of seven LSI categories with AUROCs 0.929–0.821; temporal validation on separate CY2024 cohort confirms robustness; good-to-excellent discrimination
comments: Large-scale real-world EMS dataset is strength; class imbalance and clinical deployment considerations not addressed.

model_io.model: Random forest on free-text chief complaint words
inputs: Chief complaint text (n=9.17M derivation, n=9.84M validation)
outputs: Probability of each of 7 LSI categories

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chief complaint text alone predicts LSI receipt with temporal stability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; AUROC consistency between 2023 and 2024 cohorts

title: Inhibited radiative decay enhances single-photon emitters
task: Enhance single-photon emitters via selective inhibition of unwanted radiative decay pathways
key_results: Resolved and individually addressed tens of erbium dopants; preserved or increased lifetimes vs. bulk material; achieved efficient photon collection over large frequency range without requiring small mode volumes or high quality factors
comments: Clever inversion of conventional approach (inhibit instead of enhance radiative decay); improved coherence via lower dopant concentration is a useful side benefit for scalability.

model_io.model: W1 silicon photonic-crystal waveguide with tailored photonic bandgap

hypotheses.hypothesis: Selective inhibition of unwanted decay pathways enables efficient photon collection without requiring high Q-factors and small mode volumes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Tens of erbium dopants resolved; lifetimes preserved or increased; applicable to other spin-qubit platforms

title: Pseudo point nodal superconducting gap in spin-triplet UTe2
task: Resolve superconducting gap structure in spin-triplet UTe2
key_results: Thermal conductivity measurements reveal fully gapped state with pseudo point nodes (gap minima approach but never reach zero); threshold-like field scale observed at low fields for H∥a with strong transport anisotropy above threshold
comments: The pseudo point node conclusion constrains triplet pairing mechanisms; thermal conductivity as gap diagnostic is clean but field-dependent transport anisotropy interpretation warrants caution.

hypotheses.hypothesis: UTe2 hosts a fully gapped state with point nodes
hypotheses.result: Rejected: Pseudo point nodes confirmed; gap minima approach but never reach zero, consistent with exotic pairing

title: From stars to molecules: AI guided device-agnostic super-resolution imaging
task: Enable device-agnostic super-resolution imaging without calibration
key_results: Achieved superior accuracy and computational efficiency vs. state-of-the-art methods without calibration data; demonstrated on stellar astronomy and single-molecule localization microscopy with high resolution
comments: The universal training dataset approach elegantly sidesteps calibration burden; generalization across diverse optical setups is significant for practical deployment.

model_io.model: Deep-learning framework trained on numerically simulated diverse imaging conditions

hypotheses.hypothesis: A single model trained on diverse simulated data can generalize across different optical setups
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Model reconstructs super-resolved images without prior information or setup-specific calibration

title: Ferroelectric skyrmion crystal with honeycomb structure
task: Demonstrate electric-field-induced ferroelectric skyrmion crystal with honeycomb lattice structure
key_results: Honeycomb lattice skyrmion crystal achieved in PbTiO₃ thin films via phase-field simulations; selective manipulation of sublattices via in-plane electric field; new phase transition pathways among topological phases mediated by skyrmion interactions
comments: Phase-field simulations provide elegant proof-of-principle; honeycomb lattice geometry opens new avenues for tailoring skyrmion properties, but experimental realization and device integration remain outstanding challenges.

model_io.model: Phase-field simulations of PbTiO₃ thin films

hypotheses.hypothesis: Electric field can induce honeycomb skyrmion crystal lattice in ferroelectric PbTiO₃
hypotheses.result: Confirmed in simulation: Complex skyrmion lattice stabilized via field-guided phase diagrams; selective sublattice manipulation demonstrated

title: Broadband achromatic metalens for the short-wave infrared
task: Design broadband achromatic metalens for short-wave infrared (1.8–2.3 μm)
key_results: Focal-length variation within 6% across 1800–2300 nm; effective chromatic aberration suppression via single-bar silicon nanostructures on CaF₂ substrate; weak wavelength dependence of degree of polarization in focal spot
comments: FDTD-validated design achieving broadband achromaticity is impressive; practical integration and fabrication tolerance remain to be demonstrated at SWIR wavelengths.

model_io.model: CaF₂-substrate metalens with periodic silicon bar nanostructures (900 nm period)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tuned silicon nanostructures enable simultaneous dispersion compensation and phase modulation for broadband SWIR focusing
hypotheses.result: Confirmed in simulation: 6% focal-length variation; weak wavelength-dependent DoP; compact achromatic design achieved

title: Channel-resolved excitation trends in Si, GaAs, and NiO for sub-GeV dark matter detection
task: Develop phenomenological framework for channel-resolved excitation responses in sub-GeV dark matter detection
key_results: Si remains electron-dominated, GaAs phonon-dominated under moderate perturbations, NiO magnon-dominated within adopted parameterization; unit-weight sensitivity analysis reveals GaAs classification is conditional on material-guided channel weighting; total response decomposed into channel-resolved contributions
comments: Careful comparative framework highlights material-specialization picture but transparently acknowledges model dependence; absolute rate predictions await ab initio calculations.

model_io.model: Phenomenological dark matter scattering calculations for Si, GaAs, NiO

hypotheses.hypothesis: Different condensed-matter targets preferentially emphasize distinct low-energy excitation signatures
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Si electron-dominated, GaAs phonon-dominated, NiO magnon-dominated; hierarchy depends on response functions and channel weights

title: Unveiling the structural, electronic, optical, and transport properties of Cs₂SeCl₆ double perovskite for clean energy
task: Investigate structural, electronic, optical, and transport properties of Cs₂SeCl₆ lead-free double perovskite
key_results: Stable cubic phase with ductile character; indirect semiconducting bandgap; mixed ionic–covalent bonding; strong absorption in visible-UV; favorable thermoelectric response with notable Seebeck coefficient; phonon dynamical stability confirmed
comments: Comprehensive DFT study establishes Cs₂SeCl₆ as promising lead-free alternative; however, actual device performance and stability under ambient conditions remain to be demonstrated experimentally.

model_io.model: DFT calculations (WIEN2k framework with GGA and mBJ-GGA functionals)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cs₂SeCl₆ exhibits structural, electronic, and optical properties suitable for optoelectronic applications
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Stable cubic phase, ductile character, strong visible-UV absorption, favorable thermoelectric properties

title: Integrated air-coupled ultrasonic transducer with front-end preamplification for structural health monitoring
task: Develop integrated air-coupled ultrasonic transducer with improved signal quality for structural health monitoring
key_results: SNR improvement of 23.70–34.80 dB with integrated preamplification vs. unamplified baseline over 400–2000 mm; outperformed external preamplification by 10.43–12.92 dB; demonstrated non-contact wall-climbing robotic inspection
comments: Elegant solution addressing multiple coupled constraints (impedance mismatch, weak signals, EMI) via integrated architecture; practical robotic validation strengthens applicability.

model_io.model: Air-coupled ultrasonic sensing-head with hollow-glass-microsphere matching layer and conformal shielding
inputs: Ultrasonic pulse at 400–2000 mm propagation distance

hypotheses.hypothesis: Integrated front-end preamplification outperforms external preamplification for weak-signal reception
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 10.43–12.92 dB improvement over external configuration under shielded conditions

title: A short review on the maximum clique problem algorithms with classical, AI, and quantum methods
task: Review Maximum Clique Problem algorithms across classical, AI, and quantum methods
key_results: Comprehensive update to prior 1994, 1999, 2014 reviews; coverage of classical algorithms, graph neural networks, and quantum approaches
comments: Review format limits concrete quantitative findings; value lies in synthesis of disparate methodologies for a classic NP-complete problem.

title: Magnetic spin and orbital Hall effects in centrosymmetric ferromagnets
task: Elucidate distinct mechanisms of magnetic spin and orbital Hall effects in centrosymmetric ferromagnets
key_results: Orbital multipole plays central role in MOHE with no analogue in MSHE; magnetic orbital Hall conductivity differs significantly for parallel vs. perpendicular field directions while MSHE conductivity remains identical in magnitude
comments: Clear theoretical distinction between MSHE and MOHE mechanisms advances understanding of angular momentum transport; orbital multipole concept is conceptually elegant.

model_io.model: Band structure calculations for centrosymmetric ferromagnets

hypotheses.hypothesis: MSHE and MOHE have fundamentally different physical origins in centrosymmetric ferromagnets
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Orbital multipole distinguishes MOHE; field-direction dependence differs between effects; dominant k-points differ in orbital character

title: Observation of unidirectional s-p orbital topological edge states in driven photonic lattices
task: Realize higher-orbital Floquet topological insulators with unidirectional edge states
key_results: Demonstrated topological edge modes of s-p orbitals traveling unidirectionally around corners in driven photonic lattices; synthetic π magnetic flux per plaquette generated via staggered s-p couplings
comments: Novel approach combining orbital degree of freedom with periodic driving to realize topological phases; demonstrates the power of synthetic dimensions for engineering topological properties.

model_io.model: Bipartite square photonic lattice with periodically modulated s-p couplings

hypotheses.hypothesis: Orbital degree of freedom combined with synthetic flux enables new topological phases
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Both Chern and anomalous Floquet topological insulators realized; turning off flux makes system trivial

title: Pressure-induced structure transformation and collapse of ferromagnetism in van der Waals insulator
task: Characterize pressure-driven structural and magnetic transformations in van der Waals magnet CrBr₃
key_results: Intrinsic trimorphism with unreported trigonal phase discovered; pressure drives trigonal phase growth, rhombohedral phase becomes undetectable above 8.4 GPa; ferromagnetism collapses above 5.8 GPa due to increasing AFM-coupled Cr moments in AA stackings; DFT and atomistic simulations support scenario
comments: Comprehensive experimental and computational study establishes pressure sensitivity of vdW magnetic structure; collapse of ferromagnetism linked to stacking-dependent magnetic coupling is physically compelling.

model_io.model: CrBr₃ single crystals under hydrostatic pressure

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pressure-driven phase transformation quenches ferromagnetism in CrBr₃
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Trigonal phase growth correlates with AFM-coupled moments; ferromagnetism collapses above 5.8 GPa

title: Diffusion asymmetry of repulsive skyrmions in structured environment
task: Investigate asymmetric diffusion of repulsive skyrmions in structured microfluidic chambers
key_results: Skyrmions exhibit asymmetric diffusion through off-center asymmetric gate; diffusion depends on gate symmetry, opening width, and skyrmion density; emergent transient rotational dynamics from repulsive skyrmion–skyrmion interactions; simulations agree with rate-equation solutions
comments: Elegant demonstration of collective effects in confined skyrmion systems; connection to active matter physics broadens appeal but interparticle vs. geometry contributions remain partially intertwined.

model_io.model: Magnetic thin film with patterned skyrmion chambers

hypotheses.hypothesis: Asymmetric cylindrical confinement induces preferential skyrmion diffusion direction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Asymmetric diffusion observed; emergent rotational dynamics from repulsive interactions
